_comment: RQ1 on the University Course dataset (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). Whether positives include transitive pairs is not stated, so scoring is auto: closure if some gold positive is implied by other positives (the count is recorded in gold_summary). Only labelled pairs are scored. Benchmarks have no course text, so the evidence check has nothing to retrieve: the agent reported on this dataset is minus_evidence (decided 2026-11-02; cdlp/validation/README.md, Notes for the paper). full_agent is still scored but not reported.
